definitions.gloss: all one's feelings; everything in one's heart
definitions.explanation: The whole of what one feels, especially love or long-held feelings that have not been said. Used almost always with verbs of telling or pouring out, as in confessing one's love.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: To tell someone everything one feels.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つづった。
examples.english: I poured my heart out in a letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{明|あ}けた→打ち明ける：04230_uchiakeru⟧。
examples.english: On graduation day, he confessed all his feelings to the senior student he had long been in love with.

notes:
Made of ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (feeling) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + ⟦{丈|たけ}→丈：29841_take⟧ (length, extent): the full extent of one's feelings. A slightly literary phrase, common in songs, letters and love stories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける→打ち明ける：04230_uchiakeru⟧: to confess all one's feelings
- {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to tell someone how one feels
- {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつける→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧: to pour out one's feelings
- {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つづる: to put one's feelings into writing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{告白|こくはく}→告白：06742_kokuhaku⟧: confession (of love)
- ⟦{胸|むね}の{内|うち}→胸の内：21532_munenouchi⟧: one's innermost thoughts
